# ScanCode Toolkit for the CI licence and copyright scan (.github/workflows/ci.yml,
# job "licence scan"). Complete tested set for CPython 3.13 on Linux x86_64,
# each package pinned by version and hash. Install with:
#   python -m pip install --no-deps --require-hashes -r .github/scancode-requirements.txt
# --no-deps is required: scancode-toolkit-mini 32.5.0 declares pluggy>=1.0, but on
# Python 3.13 it was found to need pluggy 0.13.1 and setuptools below 81.
# CI tooling only; nothing here is shipped in the package.
